## DESeq2

```{r de-methods, results='asis'}
deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Reproduce differential expression with this package module:",
  "diffexp_out <- run_diffexp_pipeline(dds_qc, var = \"condition\")"
)
if (!is.null(params$ppi_out)) {
  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce PPI connectivity (embedded below per contrast) with:",
    "ppi_out <- run_ppi_pipeline(diffexp_out = diffexp_out)"
  )
}
```

```{r de-helpers, include=FALSE}
emit_de_contrast <- function(comp, res_df, alpha, lfc_threshold, ppi_out = NULL) {
  n_sig <- sum(res_df$sig, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("\n\n**", n_sig, "significant genes** (padj <", alpha,
      "& |log2FC| >", lfc_threshold, ")\n\n")

  cat("\n\n##### MA plot\n\nHover over a point to see its gene name, log2 fold-change, and adjusted p-value.\n\n")
  ma_plot <- deseq2reports::plot_ma(res_df, alpha = alpha, lfc_threshold = lfc_threshold)
  ma_btn <- deseq2reports::download_plot_button(ma_plot, filename = paste0(comp, "_MA_plot"))
  deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(deseq2reports::make_interactive(ma_plot), ma_btn, center = TRUE)

  cat("\n\n##### Volcano plot\n\nHover over a point to see its gene name, log2 fold-change, and adjusted p-value. ",
      "x-axis uses shrunken log2 fold-changes (only super-extreme outliers are clipped); ",
      "y-axis is -log10(padj). ",
      "Points are coloured up/down only when padj < alpha and |log2FC| > ", lfc_threshold, ".\n\n", sep = "")
  volcano_plot <- deseq2reports::plot_volcano(res_df, alpha = alpha, lfc_threshold = lfc_threshold)
  volcano_btn <- deseq2reports::download_plot_button(volcano_plot, filename = paste0(comp, "_volcano_plot"))
  deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(deseq2reports::make_interactive(volcano_plot), volcano_btn, center = TRUE)

  cat("\n\n##### DEG table\n\n")
  cat("\n\nFull differential expression results (all tested genes, unfiltered); ",
      "sort by any column or search by gene using the box below.\n\n", sep = "")
  deg_btn <- deseq2reports::download_table_button(res_df, filename = paste0(comp, "_deg_results"))
  deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(deseq2reports::make_deg_datatable(res_df), deg_btn)

  ppi <- if (!is.null(ppi_out) && !is.null(ppi_out$by_comparison)) {
    ppi_out$by_comparison[[comp]]
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  if (!is.null(ppi) && !is.null(ppi$plot)) {
    cat("\n\n##### PPI connectivity\n\n")
    cat("\n\nSTRING protein-interaction subgraph among significant DEGs ",
        "(falling back to top-ranked genes when fewer than two DEGs share an edge). ",
        "BioNERO-style layout: Louvain communities, degree-sized nodes; ",
        "**hover any node** to see its gene name. Top ",
        length(ppi$hubs), " hubs stay labelled. ",
        "Genes with no STRING edge to another seed gene are omitted ",
        "(they have degree 0 in this induced network).\n\n", sep = "")
    n_sig <- if (!is.null(ppi$n_sig)) ppi$n_sig else NA_integer_
    n_mapped <- if (!is.null(ppi$n_mapped)) ppi$n_mapped else NA_integer_
    cat("<p><strong>Gene filter funnel:</strong> ",
        if (!is.na(n_sig)) paste0(n_sig, " significant DEGs → ") else "",
        ppi$n_seed, " seeds → ",
        if (!is.na(n_mapped)) paste0(n_mapped, " mapped to STRING → ") else "",
        ppi$n_with_edge, " with ≥1 STRING edge among seeds",
        if (!is.null(ppi$max_plot_nodes) && ppi$n_with_edge > ppi$n_plotted) {
          paste0(" → top ", ppi$n_plotted, " by degree plotted (cap ",
                 ppi$max_plot_nodes, ")")
        } else {
          paste0(" → ", ppi$n_plotted, " plotted")
        },
        ".</p>\n", sep = "")
    ppi_btn <- deseq2reports::download_plot_button(
      ppi$plot, filename = paste0(comp, "_ppi_connectivity"),
      width = 6.5, height = 5.5
    )
    deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
      deseq2reports::make_interactive_ppi(ppi$plot),
      ppi_btn, center = TRUE
    )
    hub_df <- ppi$nodes
    if (!is.null(hub_df) && nrow(hub_df)) {
      hub_df <- hub_df[order(-hub_df$degree, hub_df$gene), , drop = FALSE]
      rownames(hub_df) <- NULL
      cat("\n\n###### Genes by connectivity (degree)\n\n")
      cat("\n\nAll ", nrow(hub_df), " genes with ≥1 STRING edge among seeds, ",
          "ranked by degree (the plot may show a degree-capped subset). ",
          "The table shows the top 10 by default; use the page-length control ",
          "or search box for the full list. The ",
          sum(hub_df$hub, na.rm = TRUE),
          " genes labelled on the plot have <code>hub = TRUE</code>.\n\n", sep = "")
      hub_btn <- deseq2reports::download_table_button(
        hub_df, filename = paste0(comp, "_ppi_hubs")
      )
      deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
        deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(hub_df, page_length = 10),
        hub_btn, center = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}

specs <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
if (is.null(specs)) {
  comps <- names(params$diffexp_out$by_comparison)
  specs <- data.frame(
    label = comps,
    class = "single",
    type = deseq2reports::classify_comparison_type(comps),
    stratum_var = NA_character_,
    stratum_level = NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
two_factor <- any(specs$class %in% c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction"))
```

```{r de-single, results='asis', eval=!two_factor}
de_pairwise <- specs$label[specs$type == "pairwise"]
de_one_vs_all <- specs$label[specs$type == "one_vs_all"]

cat("\n\n### Pairwise {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(de_pairwise) > 0) {
  for (comp in de_pairwise) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
    emit_de_contrast(comp, params$diffexp_out$by_comparison[[comp]],
                     params$alpha, params$lfc_threshold, params$ppi_out)
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo pairwise comparisons.\n\n")
}

cat("\n\n### One vs. all {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(de_one_vs_all) > 0) {
  for (comp in de_one_vs_all) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
    emit_de_contrast(comp, params$diffexp_out$by_comparison[[comp]],
                     params$alpha, params$lfc_threshold, params$ppi_out)
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo one-vs-all comparisons.\n\n")
}
```

```{r de-two-factor, results='asis', eval=two_factor}
var <- params$var
for (cls in c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction")) {
  sub <- specs[specs$class == cls, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
  title <- deseq2reports::contrast_class_title(cls, var)
  cat("\n\n### ", title, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")

  if (identical(cls, "interaction")) {
    for (comp in sub$label) {
      cat("\n\n#### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
      emit_de_contrast(comp, params$diffexp_out$by_comparison[[comp]],
                       params$alpha, params$lfc_threshold, params$ppi_out)
    }
    next
  }

  strata <- unique(sub$stratum_level)
  for (st in strata) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", st, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")
    st_sub <- sub[sub$stratum_level == st, , drop = FALSE]
    pw <- st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "pairwise"]
    ova <- st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "one_vs_all"]

    cat("\n\n##### Pairwise {.tabset}\n\n")
    if (length(pw) > 0) {
      for (comp in pw) {
        cat("\n\n###### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
        emit_de_contrast(comp, params$diffexp_out$by_comparison[[comp]],
                         params$alpha, params$lfc_threshold, params$ppi_out)
      }
    } else {
      cat("\n\nNo pairwise comparisons.\n\n")
    }

    if (length(ova) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n##### One vs. all {.tabset}\n\n")
      for (comp in ova) {
        cat("\n\n###### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
        emit_de_contrast(comp, params$diffexp_out$by_comparison[[comp]],
                         params$alpha, params$lfc_threshold, params$ppi_out)
      }
    }
  }
}
```
